title: "Ginko Tree"
author: "DK"

참으로 오랜만이었네.

천 년을 사는 은행나무는 몇십 년에 한 번씩 봐도 되지만,

백 년도 못 사는 사람은 몇 년에 한 번이라도 보고 사는 게 친척 아니겠나.

반가웠고 잘 살아줘서 고맙네. 어디에 얼마나 멀리 살아도 늘 기억하고 추억하며 열심히 살고 건강하세.

It really had been such a long time!

The ginkgo tree, which lives a thousand years, can be seen once every few decades and still be fine.

But people, who don’t even live a hundred years, should see each other at least once every few years—that’s what being relatives is all about.

It was so good to see you, and thank you for living well.

No matter where we live or how far apart we may be, let’s remember each other, cherish our memories, keep working hard, and stay healthy.

Uncle Hong, October 2026

In life there are at least 2 families

The family that you are born into and the family that you become through marriage.

By marrying Sister K, I became acquainted with her eight aunts and two uncles.

One uncle is older than Sister K's father by a few years.

But the younger uncle is nearly 20 years younger.

We made arrangements to visit him and his new wife.

He suggested instead of visiting for a dinner, we should come earlier and he will show around the town,
